scenario: A ComputationError is asserted as a fault fact a rule can match (LERR.9.1), and it is latched per (node, rule) site (LERR.9.5): a second identical fault at the same site is a suppressed no-op and the handler does not fire again. Drives the Int division of the RHS `let` in rule `divide` (activation-time, so rule = "divide"; Int slots, because an Int division by zero traps and a Float one is IEEE), the fault-fact queue (LERR.9.7), and the engine's replacement rule. Both faults read the divisor from S.b, so every slot of the two fault facts is equal. Pin: assert S(a, b=0); pump; assert S(b2, b=0); pump. Messages are ['DIVIDE_BY_ZERO divide'] once; `divide` itself never logs.
rules_ds:
schema S scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    a: Int mutable
    b: Int mutable

rule divide:
    S s
->
    let q = s.a / s.b
    log critical "q {q}"

rule handler:
    ComputationError e
->
    log critical "{e.kind} {e.rule}"
